title: Analysis code for "Measuring How Data Preparation and Task Definition Choices Affect Reported Accuracy in Introvert-Extrovert Classification"
description: Python code that measures how four data preparation decisions change the reported accuracy of introvert-extrovert classification: whether respondents who identify as neither are kept, whether resampling happens before or inside cross-validation folds, whether duplicate rows are removed, and whether feature selection happens before or inside folds. Each condition is evaluated with 5-fold cross-validation repeated 10 times on a public Kaggle dataset and on the Multidimensional Introversion-Extraversion Scales development data. The datasets themselves are not redistributed; the repository documents where to download each one. Every table and figure in the accompanying preprint is produced by a named script here.
